excerpt: 'The heart of PIP-II is an 800-MeV superconducting linac accelerator. It will be located in a new tunnel with new service buildings and connected to the present Booster through a new transfer line.' Figure 2 caption references the site plan relative to Wilson Hall; no coordinates given.
title: Preliminary Modelling of Radiation Levels at the Fermilab PIP-II Linac
